acceptance_criteria: Given a valid account, When the user requests a password reset, Then a reset email with a link is sent.
Given a reset link older than its expiry window, When the user clicks it, Then the user sees a clear 'This link has expired' message and can request a new one.

Given more than N reset requests for the same account within a short window, When the rate limit is exceeded, Then the endpoint returns a clear rate-limit response instead of accepting further requests.
Given an email address that is invalid or malformed, When the user submits the reset request, Then the user sees a specific invalid email message rather than a generic 500 error.
Given a reset token that has already been used to successfully change the password, When it is used again, Then the request is rejected because the token was already used.
